title: Surreal Cosmic Kitchen
description: A surreal scene depicts a yellow refrigerator with its door open, emitting golden light beams and orbs toward a stained glass window featuring multiple eyes. To the left, a large circular cosmic mandala contains rings of stylized faces, a central red orb, and is surrounded by swirling green and purple brushstrokes against a black background.
prompt: A surreal painting of a kitchen scene with a bright yellow refrigerator with open door emitting golden rays and floating orbs, next to a sink and a large stained glass window filled with multiple stylized eyes in purple green and gold, on the left a massive intricate circular cosmic mandala with concentric rings of black and white faces and a glowing red central orb, surrounded by swirling green purple brushstrokes on a black background, mystical symbolic art
